name: setup
description: The setup() system call is used internally by the kernel to initialize devices and filesystems configured into the kernel and then mounts the root filesystem. It is called once from within the kernel and cannot be invoked by user processes, which will always receive EPERM.

return_value.success: Not applicable; always fails for user processes
return_value.failure: Returns -1 and sets errno to EPERM

versions: Removed in Linux 2.1.121. The calling sequence varied: at some times setup() has had a single argument void*BIOS and at other times a single argument int magic.
